rationale: The message names the aspect and the constructor and states the reason correctly, without language defects.
codeChange: The only report site (IntroduceConstructorParameterAdvice.Implement, constructor.IsStatic check) is unreachable: AdviceFactory.IntroduceParameterCore first calls Validate( constructor, AdviceKind.IntroduceParameter ), whose eligibility rule (_introduceParameterRule in EligibilityRuleFactory.cs) includes MustNotBeStatic() and throws an InvalidOperationException for a static constructor. The diagnostic is therefore never reported; either remove it or make Validate report it instead of throwing.
